title: Ordinary etale system support operations exist
statement: For a compactification c of f:X→Y and a natural number l, there is a support presentation for every finite l-power-torsion coefficient sequence: ∀ B : Coefficients l, Support c B.rings.

proof.text: Construct the normalized proper direct image and its exact inverse on the vertical sequence site using the sheaf-ring coefficient adjunction. Construct the exact open extension by zero from the localization adjunction, then package the proper and open factors as Support for each coefficient sequence.

mathlib_searches.query: ordinary etale system support proper direct image open extension by zero
mathlib_searches.results: No existing declaration packages this generic Support family; use the stated ringed-site and system-level constructions.

theorem etaleSystemProjectionSupportData_nonempty
